subject: MAP: Sustained stress test results + unit-econ recap for LedgerCore
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@ledgercore.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Martin <tom.martin@ledgercore.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + throughput questions

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick follow up. Our infra team asked for a concrete throughput run they can reproduce: sustained QPS at 2k sessions/min, 32 concurrent model contexts, average prompt length ~120 tokens, generation up to 256 tokens, and a 95th-percentile TTFT target < 250ms for single-turn latency.

Can Redwood share the exact MAP entry for the stress test (step-by-step), the raw token/sec traces, and a short unit-econ summary so our procurement team has a sense of committed costs?

If you can attach the MAP spreadsheet and a short PDF of results, procurement will be happy to move to a POC acceptance milestone.

Appreciate it — Elena

--
Elena Park
Head of Platform Engineering, LedgerCore
elena@ledgercore.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + throughput questions

Hi Elena — thanks, this is helpful and aligns with the MAP scope we discussed. Attached is a first-pass MAP workbook (ledgercore-map-v1.xlsx) and a short runbook for the sustained stress test. Summary up front:
- Sustained test target: 2k sessions/min (approx 33.3 QPS) across 32 concurrent contexts.
- Observed tokens/sec (aggregate): 18k–21k TPS during steady window.
- 95th TTFT: 220–260ms across two model variants; one variant hits the 250ms target under optimized batching.
- Unit econ (hosted): ~$0.0018/token for configured run (see sheet 'UnitEcon').

Next steps: Rishi/Neha and I will ingest your sample traces and run the same job in our dedicated candidate pool. Can we schedule a 30-min window tomorrow at 10:00 PT to kick off?

Attachments: ledgercore-map-v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), sustained-stress-samples-2027-05.tar.gz (sample inputs)

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: internal: MAP stress run plan (LedgerCore)

Internal notes / playbook: please see below — I'll own the collection of metrics and the final ETL into the MAP workbook.

1) Environment- Candidate pool: dedicated c6-gpu-reserve-3 (4xA100 equivalent); pinned CUDA kernels for int8 run.
2) Model variants- vA (qa-optimized) and vB (latency-optimized quant). We'll run 3x warmup passes then a 30-min steady window.
3) Load pattern- 32 concurrent contexts, Poisson arrival to match production, mean prompt 120 tokens, gen cap 256. Target aggregate steady QPS 33.3.
4) Measurements- tokens/sec (agg and per-shard), sustained QPS (1m rolling), TTFT p50/p95, token-level cost estimates, and memory/KV hit ratios. Save traces to /s3/redwood/ldg485/20270502/*.
5) Failure modes to capture- queue backlog, model OOM, kernel fallbacks; include latency tail when batch sizes spike.

I'll push raw traces and a CSV summary into the Drive link by EOD. Neha — can you run the unit-econ calc with current pricing tiers and include the 12-month committed discount scenarios (5%/10%/15%)?

Rishi
Senior Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: internal: MAP stress run plan (LedgerCore)

Quick update — ran the unit-econ scenarios and added a sheet to the MAP workbook. Highlights:
- Baseline hosted list price: $0.0021/token. Estimated for this sustained pattern (with batching/kv cache) -> effective unit cost $0.0018/token.
- With 12-month commit: 5% -> $0.00171/token; 10% -> $0.00162/token; 15% -> $0.00153/token.
- Monthly commit needed to reach lowest band: ~1.2B tokens/month (see 'CommitModel' tab).
- Monthly cost estimate for the POC (30-day steady window equivalent): ~$54k (hosted list); with caching and dedicated pooling that drops to ~$39k in observed runs.

I've uploaded throughput-summary-v2.pdf to the Drive link and left notes on assumptions. Rishi — traces look clean; I flagged one spike at 2027-05-02T15:12:40 where batching collapsed to singletons for ~45s — likely due to a short upstream burst.

Neha
Sr. Pricing Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@ledgercore.com>, Tom Martin <tom.martin@ledgercore.com>, procurement@ledgercore.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Sustained stress test results + unit-econ recap (LDG-485)

Hi Elena / Tom — thanks for the patience while we ran the stress window. Attaching a short summary and the MAP workbook. Key takeaways:

- Repro steps: runbook in ledgercore-map-v1.xlsx, warmup 3 cycles, then 30-min steady window with Poisson arrivals and 32 concurrent contexts. We used your sample prompts.
- Throughput: steady aggregate tokens/sec = 19.2k (vA), 21.6k (vB quant); steady QPS = 34.8 (vA), 39.2 (vB).
- Latency: p50 TTFT = 110–125ms; p95 TTFT = 205ms (vB) and 245ms (vA) under the same window. vB meets your 250ms p95 target consistently when we enable KV-prefetch + tuned batching.
- Concurrency/TTFT behavior: above ~40 QPS we observed p95 climbing rapidly due to backend KV misses; recommended production config includes KV cache warming and a small buffer pool.
- Unit economics (observed): effective token cost = $0.00172/token (vB path). With a 12-month 10% commit, ledger's committed rate would be ~$0.00155/token.

Attachments: throughput-summary-v2.pdf, ledgercore-map-v1.xlsx (MAP workbook). Also uploaded raw traces to the Drive link for your infra team.

Next ask: if the numbers look good, can procurement confirm whether LedgerCore will sign the 12-month commit (10% discount) so we can reserve the dedicated pool and finalize SLA language? We've prep'd a draft term sheet and a DocuSign envelope (link below) to speed closure.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk through the workbook.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
